info.title: Api
info.description:
Enterprise-grade L402 data vending engine serving real-time thermodynamic Bitcoin telemetry, cryptographic proof verification, and P2P mesh consensus to autonomous AI agents and LLM swarms.

Key Capabilities:
- L402 Micropayments & Macaroon Attenuations: Programmatic pay-per-query settlement in satoshis with zero API keys. Supports parent macaroon caveat scoping (proof.attenuate) with TTLs and rate controls.
- Multi-Asset Settlement Router: Native payment support across Base-layer Lightning (btc-lightning), Liquid Bitcoin (l-btc), Taproot Assets (taproot-assets), and Base USDC (x402).
- Groth16 ZK-SNARK & OTS Proof Verification: Execute cryptographic verification for supplied Groth16/Poseidon BN254 telemetry proofs, drift zk-SNARKs, and OpenTimestamps (OTS) Bitcoin block-header receipts.
- Agent Context State Grounding: Anchor autonomous agent prompt executions, CIDs, and dataset context hashes directly into signed Bitcoin-tip receipts (proof.ground).
- Autonomous P2P Mesh Network: Nostr-backed (NIP-01/78) peer topology broadcasting with automated quorum validation, cross-validation metrics, and node public-key provenance.
- Stratigraphy Strata Analytics: High-speed differential comparisons (stratigraphy.get_diff) and compressed record digests designed specifically for LLM context window efficiency.
- Real-Time SSE Streaming: Live Server-Sent Events (/api/v1/stratigraphy/stream) for continuous telemetry feeds.

Operational Boundaries:
- The three-asset L402 router serves supported REST surfaces; Liquid and Taproot Assets require configured providers. Check /api/v1/cost for supported versus currently available assets. Lightning is Bitcoin's payment-channel layer; Base USDC is a separate EVM x402 rail.
- MCP paid tools accept Lightning L402 and, only when configured, Base USDC x402. Query payment.get_info for current prices and advertised methods, not REST router availability. Wallet authorization and payment proofs are still required even though no API key is needed.
- MCP uses Streamable HTTP at /mcp. The paid REST SSE feed at /api/v1/stratigraphy/stream is separate, refreshes snapshots on a 30-second cadence, and supports the three configured L402 router assets, not a promised Base USDC SSE payment path. Historical strata remain indexed daily data, not native block provenance.
- Grounding receipts are off-chain, Schnorr-signed Bitcoin-tip attestations, not on-chain transactions, Groth16 proofs, or Bitcoin proof-of-work validity proofs. Groth16 verifies a defined statement bound to exact evidence; OTS verification requires an actual receipt and matching target digest, with Bitcoin attestation checked separately from calendar acceptance.
- Mesh broadcasts and quorum checks use configured, pinned peers; agreement does not establish source truth or unrestricted inbound peer discovery. Macaroon request budgets and expiry are distinct from HTTP rate limits and wallet-enforced spending caps. Enterprise deployment still requires organizational governance and records retention.

proof.notarize.description: PURPOSE & BOUNDARIES: Create a detached OpenTimestamps .ots receipt for an agent-supplied SHA256 digest using public calendars. Do NOT use this as evidence of immediate Bitcoin confirmation or as a replacement for proof.verify. USAGE GUIDELINES: Submit exactly one 64-character hexadecimal hash; decode otsProofHex into binary to save the .ots file. BEHAVIOR & CONSEQUENCES: Submits a randomized commitment to public calendars, returns pending_calendar, and fails explicitly if calendars are unavailable. Costs 250 sats via L402; X-L402-Batch-Size: 100 purchases 100 tool-scoped calls for 25000 sats.

inputSchema.description: A SHA256 digest to timestamp directly, without hashing its bytes again.

hash.description: Exactly 64 hexadecimal characters representing a SHA256 digest; no 0x prefix.

outputSchema.description: Portable detached .ots binary encoded as hexadecimal; calendar acceptance is not Bitcoin confirmation.

hash.description: Original SHA256 digest normalized to lowercase.

otsProofHex.description: Hex-encoded detached .ots file; decode as binary to save, upgrade and verify with OpenTimestamps.

otsStatus.description: Calendar receipt only; Bitcoin inclusion must be independently upgraded and verified later.

proof.get_by_hash.description: Retrieve one retained proof payload, signed receipt, or lifecycle-only status using exactly one known `hash` (proof or receipt hash, CID, snapshot digest, or submission UUID) or `jobId` (submission UUID). Looks up bounded process-local records without re-running Groth16 proof verification; receipt provenance may be checked against the current dataset, and missing payloads cannot be reconstructed. Use `proof.list` to discover indexed proof hashes and `proof.verify` to cryptographically verify supplied proof inputs.

hash.description: Required when jobId is absent; accepts a proof/receipt 64-hex hash (optional 0x), decimal snapshot digest, IPFS CID, or UUID submission job ID; unknown identifiers return 404 before payment.

jobId.description: UUID returned by proof.submit; use instead of hash, never together.

provenanceVerified.description: True only if this receipt cryptographically binds the current verified dataset chain; this does not imply an OTS Bitcoin attestation.

proof.list.description: Freely discover, filter, and paginate recent zk-proof attestation lifecycle summaries. Use limit (1-100), offset (0-1000), and optional status (verified, cached, pending, invalid). Returns bounded summaries, not full proofs or receipts. Alias: proof.status. No invoice is created.

payment.get_info.description: Query MCP pricing parameters (`action='query'`, the default) or verify authenticated settlement (`action='settle'` with a payment hash and either an L402 preimage or Base transaction hash). Use `query` for price discovery before calling paid tools; use `settle` to check payment status, not to issue an invoice. Macaroons and Lightning invoices are issued dynamically via HTTP 402 challenges with bounded expiration; operator-only admin operations are intentionally omitted.

toolName.description: Optional case-sensitive canonical MCP tool identifier (e.g., 'stratigraphy.get_digest' or 'proof.verify'); supported legacy aliases are also accepted and resolve to canonical names. When provided, filters output to return pricing specifically for that single tool. When omitted, returns the full pricing map across all registered catalog tools. Must match an exact registered tool name or supported legacy alias.

paymentMacaroon.description: Original invoice macaroon for settlement checks; separate from this paid tool's Authorization credential.

stratigraphy.get_range.description: Retrieve a contiguous span of compressed indexed stratum summaries across inclusive height or UTC date bounds. Read-only, HTTP rate-limited and L402-paid; startTarget is required, endTarget defaults to the latest indexed entry, and limit caps the returned batch at 1-100 records (default 50) without changing the requested bounds. Primary tool for compact multi-record spans; use `stratigraphy.get` for full telemetry record bodies, `stratigraphy.get_digest` for source-record fingerprints, and `stratigraphy.get_diff` for parameter deltas between two entries.

startTarget.description: Required inclusive starting indexed height (e.g. '850000') or UTC ISO date (e.g. '2026-01-01'); must resolve no later than endTarget.

endTarget.description: Optional inclusive ending indexed height, UTC ISO date, or 'latest' (default latest indexed entry, not live tip); must resolve no earlier than startTarget.

limit.description: Maximum compressed records returned from startTarget toward endTarget, 1-100 (default 50); smaller limits truncate the batch.

format.description: Compression of every returned record; does not change selected bounds.

proof.attenuate.description: Attenuate an authentic, unexpired L402 parent `macaroon` by appending restrictive `caveats` and optionally `ttlSeconds`. At least one restriction is required. Requires its own L402 authorization; the parent's payment proof remains required for child redemption. Delegation cannot widen authority or reset an inherited quota.

macaroon.description: Required authentic, unexpired parent L402 macaroon (1-8192 characters); restrictions can only narrow its scope.

caveats.description: Required list of 0-16 supported restrictions such as max_target=870000 or allowed_tools=stratigraphy.get; combines with inherited parent caveats.

ttlSeconds.description: Optional integer TTL of 1-2592000 seconds; adds an expiry caveat without extending the parent's expiry.

stratigraphy.get_diff.description: Compute signed numerical deltas (indexed height, target multiplier, percentage change, and elapsed days calculated from toTarget minus fromTarget) between two indexed stratum heights or dates. Read-only, stateless operation subject to HTTP rate limiting and L402 payment; missing stratum entries yield JSON-RPC invalid-params errors. Requires valid `fromTarget` baseline; `toTarget` defaults to `latest`. Use this tool specifically to compare two point-in-time entries. Use `stratigraphy.get` for full stratum record lookups, `stratigraphy.get_range` for continuous compact multi-record spans, and `stratigraphy.get_digest` for indexed source-record fingerprints; stratigraphy data ingest is outside this comparison tool.

fromTarget.description: Required baseline indexed height (e.g. '850000') or UTC ISO date (e.g. '2026-01-01'); compared with toTarget to calculate signed deltas. Either chronological order is allowed; only indexed entries resolve.

toTarget.description: Optional comparison indexed height (e.g. '919856'), UTC ISO date (e.g. '2026-09-01'), or 'latest' (default); deltas are toTarget minus fromTarget. 'latest' is the latest dataset entry, not the live Bitcoin tip.

stratigraphy.get_digest.description: Fetch compact source-record fingerprints and metadata for an indexed stratum height, date, or bounded date range. Returns no full record telemetry or Bitcoin block-header hash; the fingerprint is not a verification receipt. Use this tool instead of `stratigraphy.get` when a compact fingerprint is enough; use `stratigraphy.get_range` for contiguous multi-record summaries and `stratigraphy.list` for catalog discovery.

target.description: Indexed height, ISO date or inclusive ISO date range joined with '..'; latest means the newest indexed dataset entry, not the live tip.

format.description: Return a delimited string, raw metric array or terse key-value object.

result.description: A compressed result, or an array of results for a date range; hash is a deterministic source-record fingerprint, not a Bitcoin block hash or ZK proof.

proofAvailable.description: False because indexed source entries do not store per-record ZK proofs.

mesh.get_status.description: Inspect P2P peer counts, topology health, cross-validation rate, propagation latency, and quorum. Requires L402 authorization; use mesh.broadcast to distribute a snapshot. This tool does not administer peers or edit topology.

proof.ground.description: PURPOSE & BOUNDARIES: Issue a signed Bitcoin-tip receipt for either agent context (contextHash plus agentId) or a dataset CID; this is an anchor, not a ZK or Bitcoin-confirmed OTS proof. USAGE GUIDELINES: Use `proof.verify` for proof verification without anchoring or `proof.get_by_hash` for existing receipts. BEHAVIOR & CONSEQUENCES: Creates a receipt and costs 250 sats via HTTP L402 without valid credentials; the two input modes are exclusive, invalid inputs fail, and tip/provider availability is required.

annotations.verificationInput: Send { attestation: receipt } for an agent-context receipt. For a dataset receipt, parse receipt.attestation.proofPayload and send { attestation: parsedReceipt }. This verifies the signed receipt, not a Groth16 proof or Bitcoin proof-of-work.

contextHash.description: 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest binding the agent's prompt or execution state to the current block tip; normalized to lowercase.

agentId.description: Unique, trimmed caller-controlled agent instance identifier from 1 to 256 characters, named in the signed receipt.

metadata.description: Optional non-secret JSON key-value metadata bound to the signed receipt; serialized size must not exceed 16 KiB.

cid.description: IPFS CIDv0/CIDv1 or 32-byte hexadecimal dataset hash to bind into the signed receipt.

nostrEventId.description: Optional 32-byte hexadecimal Nostr event ID to bind into the signed receipt; this tool does not publish it.

context.description: Optional non-secret JSON context bound to the signed receipt (maximum 16 KiB together with the other metadata).

oneOf.description: Signed agent-context anchor, returned unchanged for verification.
Signed dataset receipt; retains the existing signed-receipt fields.

provenanceVerified.description: True only when the signed receipt binds the currently validated dataset strata chain; independent of Bitcoin OTS confirmation.

proof.verify.description: Execute cryptographic verification for supplied Groth16 telemetry or drift zk-SNARK proofs, or OpenTimestamps receipts. Returns proof validity; verification can update a bounded in-memory lifecycle index, and drift checks require a Bitcoin block provider. Use this tool to verify supplied proofs; use `proof.submit` to register new Groth16 proofs and `proof.get_by_hash` to retrieve retained proofs or signed receipts by a known identifier.

inputSchema.description: Verify either a telemetry snapshot proof or a zk.drift.v1 context-drift proof.

proof.description: Base64url-encoded Groth16/Poseidon BN254 proof string without padding.

publicInputs.description: Public constants committed by the telemetry proof; must match the data snapshot.

data.description: Telemetry snapshot payload object or array of objects containing canonical state values.

valid.description: Whether the proof is valid and bound to the snapshot.

verifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC time when this verification finished.

computationTimeMs.description: Server-side proof verification duration in milliseconds.

proof.submit.description: PURPOSE & BOUNDARIES: Submit and register a new Groth16 zk-SNARK proof with its five public signals, then attempt a Nostr NIP-78 attestation; this changes proof registry state, but does not append a proof to a Merkle tree. USAGE GUIDELINES: Use `proof.submit` strictly for registering new attestations, and use `proof.verify` instead when validating an existing proof without state mutation. Use `proof.get_by_hash` for retained submissions or `proof.ground` for a Bitcoin-tip receipt. BEHAVIOR & CONSEQUENCES: Costs 250 sats via HTTP L402 without valid credentials; malformed inputs fail validation, invalid proofs are reported, and Nostr publication status may fail separately.

mesh.broadcast.description: PURPOSE & BOUNDARIES: Sign a stored daily telemetry snapshot selected by date and distribute it to pinned mesh peers for cross-validation; arbitrary payloads or inbound peer sync publication are not supported. USAGE GUIDELINES: Use this instead of `mesh.get_status` only when sending a snapshot for peer acknowledgment. BEHAVIOR & CONSEQUENCES: Side-effecting and costs 250 sats via HTTP L402 without valid credentials; missing records, invalid agent events, unavailable peers, or failed quorum return errors.

stratigraphy.get.description: Retrieve indexed telemetry record bodies by indexed height or UTC ISO date, or query recent days and bounded date/height ranges. Returns full record fields by default; optional metrics project selected telemetry fields, and limit caps results at 1-100 (default 10). Read-only, HTTP rate-limited and L402-paid. Use `date` or `blockHeight` for single-entry deep inspection; use `stratigraphy.get_range` for compact contiguous multi-record spans, `stratigraphy.get_digest` for lightweight source-record fingerprints, `stratigraphy.get_diff` for point-in-time deltas, and `stratigraphy.list` to discover indexed bounds.

stratigraphy.list.description: Discover indexed height and UTC date bounds, available metrics, and catalog metadata. Free, parameterless, read-only discovery entry point for selecting valid strata. Once bounds are known, use `stratigraphy.get` for full record bodies, `stratigraphy.get_range` for compact contiguous spans, or `stratigraphy.get_digest` for lightweight source-record fingerprints.

post.summary: Quote a batch of MCP tool prices in satoshis
post.description: Public, read-only quote with wildcard CORS. Returns itemized fixed MCP execution prices, a total in sats, and per-tool L402 invoice-generation details. No invoice is created or settled by this endpoint. Each paid tools/call obtains its own HTTP 402 challenge; the aggregate total is not a batch credential. Descriptive pricing selectors stratigraphy.get_latest and proof.verify_zk_proof resolve to stratigraphy.get and proof.verify for quotes only, not MCP execution. Existing executable legacy aliases retain their original paid scopes. Prices are the same as payment.get_info and the actual MCP gates; REST subscription-tier prices and discounts are separate.

post.summary: Prove a context-hash bit-density drift score against a Bitcoin block
post.description: Computes an explicitly defined bit-density proxy: context and Bitcoin block hash Hamming weights, the context hash's leading-zero run, and the leading-zero count of the block's compact difficulty target. A Groth16 proof constrains the score and alignment threshold against block data from a public Bitcoin provider, not independently validated consensus. thermodynamicEntropyBits is a hash bit-balance proxy (twice the smaller of zero/one bit counts), not measured physical entropy. The proof does not establish Bitcoin consensus or PoW in-circuit. Its locally generated Groth16 key has a single-party setup, not an independently verified multiparty ceremony.

200.description: Verified Groth16 drift proof and bound score

400.description: Malformed hash, block height, or threshold

429.description: Proof-generation capacity or request rate exceeded

503.description: Bitcoin block data or proof generation is unavailable

post.description: Public `POST /api/v1/zk/verify` endpoint for Zero-Knowledge Data Integrity. Verifies the Groth16/Poseidon BN254 zk-SNARK and binds the supplied data payload to its semantic public inputs. Proofs emitted by this API are pre-verified and complete verification in under 10ms.

503.description: Zero-knowledge verifier is overloaded and temporarily unable to process the request

post.summary: Anchor an agent context to the current Bitcoin tip
post.description: Paid `POST /api/v1/zk/ground` endpoint. After a fixed 5-sat L402 settlement, fetches the current Bitcoin block height and hash, binds them to the canonical context hash, caller identifier, optional metadata, and server timestamp, then returns a Nostr-signed Epistemic Anchor Receipt. Submit the returned receipt unchanged to `POST /api/v1/zk/verify`.

proofInterpretation.description: States the public block-provider and single-party setup trust limits of the circuit proof.

snapshotDigest.description: Decimal BN254 field element digest for the bound telemetry snapshot (0 through the BN254 field modulus)

verificationKeyId.description: Verification-key identifier used by the verifier

data.description: Telemetry data to bind to the proof. Supplying this required payload enables binding verification; proof and publicInputs provide the cryptographic verification inputs.

ZkVerifyInput.description: Accepted request bodies for proof verification, including direct and wrapped epistemic-anchor receipts.

contextHash.description: SHA-256 digest of the agent context

metadata.description: Optional non-secret JSON metadata included in the signed anchor

EpistemicAnchorReceipt.description: Canonical SHA-256/Merkle attestation signed as a Nostr NIP-78 event and bound to the current Bitcoin tip

data.description: Arbitrary extension data is already permitted on this receipt.

MeshConsensus.description: Multi-node certificate over the exact emitted data snapshot. In isolation mode the certificate contains only the local node attestation.

MeshStatus.description: Output of MCP tool mesh.get_status; mesh.status is a legacy tool name.

signature.description: Optional cross-check against event.sig; not valid alone

isValidSignature.description: False for a bare key or invalid signed event

attestationCount.description: Unique trusted signers across one or two hops

trustScore.description: 0.6 per direct trusted vouch; 0.2 per second-hop vouch, capped at 1; pinned mesh keys score 1

firstSeenTimestamp.description: Earliest valid caller or NIP-01 kind 0 profile event, seconds since epoch

attestationDepth.description: 0 for pinned mesh key, 1 direct, 2 via signed introduction

agentSession.description: Optional agent-signed kind 20079 NIP-01 event. For direct attestation, event.content is JSON.stringify({networkId,snapshotDigest}). With date, it is JSON.stringify({networkId,date}) and the peer also compares the supplied signed snapshot against the selected source record. The signer must have a pinned-node, network-bound kind 30079 trust path.

snapshot.description: Complete Nostr-attested snapshot. The peer recomputes its canonical digest and verifies source attestations before signing.

wallet_configuration.description: Availability of either the primary Coinos or fallback Alby/NWC settlement configuration

ListProofAttestationsMcpTool.description: MCP proof-attestation discovery tool registered as proof.list.

name.description: Stable MCP tool name used with tools/call.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the attestation listing tool.
examples: Discover and paginate recent proof attestation lifecycle states by status without knowing a proof hash; full retained payloads require proof.get_by_hash.

parameters.description: Optional filters accepted by the attestation listing tool.

ListProofAttestationsResult.description: Recent indexed proof attestations and the total matching count.

attestations.description: Indexed proof attestations ordered from newest to oldest.

total.description: Total matching records before the result limit is applied.

ProofAttestationRecord.description: One indexed zk-SNARK verification and Nostr attestation record.

snapshotDigest.description: Snapshot CID or decimal Poseidon digest bound to the proof.

submittedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the proof entered the lifecycle index.

attestationCount.description: Number of recorded Nostr NIP-78 attestations.

meshQuorum.description: Whether the attestation count meets the current mesh quorum.

SubmitZkProofMcpTool.description: MCP proof ingestion tool registered as proof.submit.

name.description: Stable MCP tool name used with tools/call.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the proof ingestion tool.
examples: Submit a new Groth16/Poseidon zk-SNARK proof payload and public signals to the data engine for verification, lifecycle indexing, and Nostr NIP-78 attestation broadcast.

requiredInputs.description: Input property names required for every submission.

optionalInputs.description: Optional input property names accepted by the submission.

SubmitZkProofResult.description: Immediate proof ingestion and Nostr publication result.

proofHash.description: Lowercase 0x-prefixed SHA-256 fingerprint of the canonical proof.

jobId.description: Server-generated submission job ID accepted by proof.get_by_hash.

ProofByHashMcpTool.description: MCP proof and lifecycle lookup tool registered as proof.get_by_hash.

name.description: Stable MCP tool name used with tools/call.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the proof and lifecycle lookup.
examples: Fetch a recorded ZK proof or receipt by hash fingerprint/CID. Do NOT use to generate new proofs or anchors.

identifiers.description: Alternative lookup keys; provide either hash or jobId.

exampleResult.description: A status-only lookup result omits proofPayload when the payload is not retained.

jobId.description: Submission job ID when a proof payload is retained.

proofPayload.description: Optional retained proof or signed receipt payload; omitted for status-only records.

StratigraphyCatalogMcpTool.description: MCP dataset discovery tool registered as stratigraphy.list.

name.description: Stable MCP tool name used with tools/call.

description.description: Human-readable purpose of the catalog discovery tool.
examples: Discover available stratigraphy datasets, date ranges, total recorded epochs, block height bounds, and available telemetry metrics without requiring prior knowledge of exact snapshot parameters.

StratigraphyCatalog.description: Discoverable bounds and metric inventory for the stratigraphy dataset.

totalSnapshots.description: Total number of daily stratigraphy snapshots currently available.

oldestBlock.description: Lowest block height in the deterministic daily snapshot index.

newestBlock.description: Highest block height in the deterministic daily snapshot index.

availableMetrics.description: Dot-delimited telemetry metric paths available in each snapshot.

items.description: Dot-delimited path of an available telemetry metric.

dateBounds.description: Inclusive ISO date bounds of the available snapshots.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 date of the oldest available snapshot.

endDate.description: ISO 8601 date of the newest available snapshot.

type.description: JSON Schema primitive type accepted by the tool parameter.

minimum.description: Inclusive minimum integer value when applicable.

maximum.description: Inclusive maximum integer value when applicable.

format.description: JSON Schema string format when applicable.

description.description: Detailed formatting and behavioral contract for the parameter.

allowedValues.description: Allowed string values for an enum or array parameter.

required.description: Whether callers must provide this parameter.

prevHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the prior indexed stratum, or 64 zeroes for genesis; not a Bitcoin block hash.

stratumHash.description: Domain-separated SHA-256 hash of this source-record fingerprint, index, and prevHash.

otsProof.description: Base64-encoded serialized .ots receipt, present after a successful calendar stamp.

NostrAttestation.description: NIP-01 signed NIP-78 attestation over the payload before this block was attached

target_multiplier.description: Numeric distance multiplier parsed from the day's title

difficulty_epoch_progress.description: Estimated progress through the current 14-day difficulty epoch

thermodynamic_signal.description: Qualitative target-distance band derived from the multiplier

invoice.description: Invoice or payment request for the selected settlement asset

macaroon.description: Signed first-party macaroon containing payment hash, tier, validity, exact amount, payment asset, and issuing provider caveats

valid_until.description: Unix timestamp in seconds after which this pass is invalid

price_sats.description: Dynamic price bound into this pass and its invoice

original_price_sats.description: Dynamic scarcity price before the presenting agent's tier discount

retry_after.description: Seconds until the client may request another payment invoice
